MonkTranscendence.name: Transcendence
MonkTranscendence.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals the lowest nearby allied Hero for 104 and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

MonkIronFists.name: Iron Fists
MonkIronFists.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 110% bonus damage and gives 25% increased Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

MonkInsight.name: Insight
MonkInsight.description: Quest: Every 3rd Basic Attack restores 14 Mana, grants a stack of Insight, and gives 25% increased Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. Reward: Upon getting 100 stacks of Insight, every 3rd attack also reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.75 seconds.

MonkSpiritAlly.name: Spirit Ally
MonkSpiritAlly.description: Place a Spirit Ally that heals allied Heroes in a large area around it for 2% of their maximum Health every second. Has 150 Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Spirit Allies.

MonkEarthAlly.name: Earth Ally
MonkEarthAlly.description: Place an Earth Ally that grants nearby allied Heroes 50 Physical Armor against Heroic Basic Attacks, reducing damage taken by 50%. Has 400 Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Earth Allies.

MonkAirAlly.name: Air Ally
MonkAirAlly.description: Place an Air Ally that gives allied Heroes 20% Spell Power, grants vision, and reveals a large area around it. Has 300 Health and lasts 10 seconds. Kharazim can Radiant Dash to Air Allies.

MonkBlindingSpeedRadiantDash.name: Blinding Speed
MonkBlindingSpeedRadiantDash.description: Decreases Radiant Dash's cooldown by 2 seconds and increases the maximum number of charges by 1.

MonkHeavenlyZealBreathofHeaven.name: Heavenly Zeal
MonkHeavenlyZealBreathofHeaven.description: Increases Breath of Heaven's Movement Speed bonus to 30%. Radiant Dashing to an ally increases the healing they receive from Breath of Heaven by 50% for 3.5 seconds.

MonkBlazingFistsDeadlyReach.name: Blazing Fists
MonkBlazingFistsDeadlyReach.description: Increase the duration of Deadly Reach by 100%. Every 3rd Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Deadly Reach by 0.75 seconds.

MonkHeroicAbilityDivinePalm.name: Divine Palm
MonkHeroicAbilityDivinePalm.description: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 if they take fatal damage in the next 4 seconds.

MonkHeroicAbilitySevenSidedStrike.name: Seven-Sided Strike
MonkHeroicAbilitySevenSidedStrike.description: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

MonkQuicksilverRadiantDash.name: Quicksilver
MonkQuicksilverRadiantDash.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally gives Kharazim and the target 30% bonus Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

GenericTalentSpellShield.name: Spell Shield
GenericTalentSpellShield.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

MonkSixthSense.name: Sixth Sense
MonkSixthSense.description: While Stunned or Rooted, gain 75 Physical Armor against Hero Basic Attacks for 4 seconds, reducing their damage by 75%.

MonkCleansingTouchRadiantDash.name: Cleansing Touch
MonkCleansingTouchRadiantDash.description: Radiant Dashing to an ally makes them Unstoppable for 1 second.

MonkWayoftheHundredFistsRadiantDash.name: Way of the Hundred Fists
MonkWayoftheHundredFistsRadiantDash.description: Radiant Dashing to an enemy launches a rapid volley of 6 Basic Attacks dealing 45% damage each.

MonkEchoofHeavenBreathofHeaven.name: Echo of Heaven
MonkEchoofHeavenBreathofHeaven.description: Breath of Heaven heals 75% of its normal amount, but heals a second time 3 seconds later.

MonkPeacefulReposeDivinePalm.name: Peaceful Repose
MonkPeacefulReposeDivinePalm.description: Divine Palm's healing amount is increased by 75% and its cooldown is set to 5 seconds if the Hero does not die.

MonkFistsofLegendTrait.name: Fists of Legend
MonkFistsofLegendTrait.description: Gain 50% of the benefit from both level 1 talents that were not chosen.

GenericTalentStormShield.name: Storm Shield
GenericTalentStormShield.description: Activate to give all nearby allied Heroes a Shield for 20% of their max Health for 3 seconds.

MonkEpiphany.name: Epiphany
MonkEpiphany.description: Activate to restore 70% of Kharazim's maximum Mana and refill 2 charges of Radiant Dash.
